name: Omri
title: Founder of Israel's most powerful dynasty
summary: Omri was a military commander who seized power in Israel after a civil war and established a dynasty that ruled for several generations. He built Samaria as the new capital and made Israel a regional power, but he continued the idolatry that characterized the northern kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Proclaimed king by the army
keyEvents.description: When the people heard that Zimri had killed King Elah, all Israel proclaimed the military commander Omri as king while they were besieging the Philistine city of Gibbethon.

keyEvents.title: Civil war against Tibni
keyEvents.description: Israel was divided into two factions—some followed Tibni, others Omri. After several years of fighting, Omri prevailed, and Tibni died.

keyEvents.title: The Founding of Samaria
keyEvents.description: Omri bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer and built a new city that became Israel's capital. The city remained the capital throughout the entire history of the northern kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Assessment of His Reign
keyEvents.description: Omri did what was evil in the Lord's sight, acting more wickedly than all who had been before him. He followed the sinful path of Jeroboam.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Successor of Omri
keyEvents.description: After twelve years of reign, Omri died and was buried in Samaria. His son Ahab succeeded to the throne and continued his father's sinful practices.
